//: nest build uses this rather than tsconfig.nestjs.json directly. That file's include list also carries test/nestjs.e2e-spec.ts, so a build run through it has no single source root and tsc mirrors the full path from the workspace root, landing the entry point at dist/src/nestjs/main.js instead of dist/nestjs/main.js. This one fixes rootDir and drops the test file so the emitted layout matches what start:nestjs runs.
